_comment_perfil: NO `model` KEY, ON PURPOSE (24/09/2026 — repodocs ADR-026). A pin written here cannot win: the account's server-managed settings outrank every local file. And `opus[1m]` was a version pin wearing a window suffix — the 1M variant existed only for the previous Opus, so every session was born on it while the catalog already offered the newer one. To pin a model again, NAME the version: "model": "opus55". The highest effortLevel a FILE accepts is 'xhigh'; use /effort max for a single session.
_comment_autoMode: O classificador do auto mode e uma camada SEPARADA das regras de permissions. Por padrao ele bloqueia escrita no proprio settings.json (o agente poderia ampliar as proprias permissoes). '$defaults' mantem todas as regras embutidas; a linha seguinte abre so este caso. Mantenha a regra ESTREITA — 'allow' generico aqui desliga o classificador na pratica.

allow: Creating or editing .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json and .claude/README.md inside this project directory. The repository owner has explicitly opted in to this. Writes to settings files anywhere else, including the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json, are NOT covered by this rule.
